headline: Finland's Iceye Launches 41 Euro per Share Takeover Offer for Avio
summary: Finnish satellite developer Iceye launched a takeover bid for Italian aerospace and space propulsion group Avio at 41 euros per share. The company stated it aims to create a European defence champion while maintaining Avio's workforce in Italy.
why: Avio is Italy's leading launcher and rocket propulsion manufacturer, playing a central role in European space access through the Vega rocket family.

impacts.name: Avio
impacts.why: Iceye proposed an acquisition offer at 41 euros per share to create a consolidated European defence entity.
